privacy.intro: El Portal is hosted in the EU and built on your consent. This page lists everything we store, everything we never touch, and how to take it all back.

buckets.title: Mood, habit, and cycle data
buckets.lede: The entries you log. Without these the app cannot work for you.
stored: Mood and feelings you check in with
Habits you mark done or undone
Work cycles, goals, and reflections you write
neverStored: Browsing history or activity on other sites
buckets.meta: Stored only after you explicitly consent at signup.

buckets.title: Anonymous usage stats
buckets.lede: We log feature taps, navigation, and load times so we can see what works and what is slow. No content, no cookies.
neverStored: The text you write or the values you log
buckets.meta: EU-hosted in Frankfurt. Your toggle controls everything.

buckets.title: Reports and your reactions
buckets.lede: When you ask El Portal for an AI report, we save the report and how you reacted to it. Over time, this helps us write reports that feel more like you.
stored: The mood and habit summary the report was based on
The report text we wrote you
Your reaction (kept open, dismissed, asked again, marked helpful)
neverStored: Your name or account ID (replaced with a random hash)
Slide text or anything you write into a slide
buckets.meta: Encrypted at rest. Never sold, never sent to ad networks, never shared with third-party AI providers.

privacy.providersHeading: Four providers, all in the EU.

providers.name: Supabase
providers.purpose: Primary database. Stores your account, entries, and consent log.

providers.name: PostHog Cloud
providers.purpose: Anonymous usage stats. Only active if you opt in.

providers.name: Vercel
providers.purpose: Hosts the app and runs server functions.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.purpose: Generates AI report text. Only invoked when you request a report.

privacy.rightsHeading: Take it all back, any time.

rights.title: Export everything
rights.description: Download a single file with everything we have on you.

rights.title: Delete everything
rights.description: Permanently erases your account and all your data. Cannot be undone.

rights.title: Change your mind any time
rights.description: Flip any toggle in Settings — Privacy. We apply the change right away and keep a record of every choice.

rights.title: Get in touch
rights.description: If something feels off, write to us or contact your local data protection authority.

description.heading: Description of Service
description.body: El Portal is a mobile-first personal operating system designed for intentional living and peak performance. It provides tools for habit tracking, deep work cycles, task management, and personal analytics through a structured Version → Cycle → Day framework.
